final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.ordertypedist AS otd, AVG(s.instownpct) AS v FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT otd, AVG(v) AS av FROM s1 GROUP BY otd), s3 AS (SELECT s1.transref AS transref, s1.otd AS otd, s1.v AS v, s1.v * 1.0 / NULLIF(s2.av, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.otd = s2.otd), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(v) AS av FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.transref, s3.otd, s3.v, s3.ratio, s3.v - s4.av AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.v > s4.av) SELECT AVG(v), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM s5
